lods.name: lod0
lods.use: the player's car and the cockpit camera; a desktop hero

lods.name: proxy-mid
lods.use: cars further out than mid: one draw, no moving parts

lods.name: proxy-far
lods.use: the furthest cars: one draw, no moving parts

car.frame: GameMog's: +Z forward, +Y up, +X to the car's left; metres; the origin at the wheelbase midpoint on the ground. Every part's geometry is local to its origin (its pivot), given in car space.

tyres.note: Round again: the source pressed each tyre flat where it meets the ground. The axle stands at its loaded height, so a round tyre reaches below the ground plane by -lowest; the road hides it.

spin.sense: A positive angle about +X rolls the car forward (+Z): add distance / radius.

steer.sense: A positive angle about +Y turns the front wheels to the car's left (+X). Parent a front wheel's spin part to its steer part (both pivot at the wheel centre). The suspension arms stay in the body and do not follow.

steeringWheel.sense: A positive angle about this axis (the column, pointing to the driver) turns it anticlockwise as the driver sees it: a left turn. In lod0 and lod1 only; mid and far keep it in the body.

livery.channels: Linear weights: R the upper colour, G the coachline, B the letters, A the race number; the gold full stop is G and B together (gold = min(G, B)), and what is left (1 - R - G - B + gold - A) is the lower colour. Sample it as data (no colour-space conversion, premultiplied alpha off) and mix the scheme's linear colours with the weights.

slots.note: Atlas uv rectangles [u0, v0, u1, v1] of the two WHY. wordmarks (the engine-cover flanks) and the race number (the nose top), where another scheme hides them (letters and number weights to the upper colour) or draws its own.

livery.marks: The WHY. name and wordmark are the owner's trademarks: CC0 gives away the model, not the marks.

car.trim: Materials "trim" (and every proxy) colour each vertex from palette[slot]: the slot is a Uint8 attribute (layout key ":slot").
car.ao: Every sub has a Uint8 ambient-occlusion attribute (layout key ":ao", 0 to 1 normalised), baked by ray tracing in the source: apply it to indirect light.
